name: xoga750-fix5-masters-match-old-dev
description: DEV ONLY. Makes the OGA dev Web XTR masters equal what the tester's legacy run used, so OGA reproduces the Old Opera output of XOGA-750 (Old: Overall 313, Netted 74). Two documents are replaced: XTRFills_Broker_CurrentUser_Master.xlsx (CFS rows for ig and Ssundaram removed) and MMVT_MissingDeals_Master.xlsx (rows removed from sheets XTR Fills Conversion (44) and XTR Fills Conversion Options (37) that the legacy 13-Nov MMVT copy does not have: accounts 9A400, 9A400LC, 9A400LC_SMA, 9A811, 9A811LC, 93488389 for products SBT ZCT ZLT ZMT ZWT CT_Z RS HRS SB_Z yECO TF FCPO yOBM OMW HSO yOCO TFO OCPO). Simulated on the 05-Nov CSV with the legacy logic: futures matching conversion 291 (ASharma 135, PPatil 12, PSoni1 66, HGill 78) = Old Overall futures 291. The tool backs up the replaced rows; undo restores the 23 Nov masters. Files: D:/oga/analysis/xoga-750/masters-match-old/. NOTE: production legacy books SSUNDARAM and IG on 05-Nov, so this makes dev match the tester's Old file, not production.
